description: Pinned public repositories scanned by scripts/Invoke-ScanRegression.ps1. Every entry is checked out at an exact commit so analyzer changes, not upstream drift, move the baseline. Regenerate a baseline with -UpdateBaselines and review the diff.

repositories.name: App-vNext_Polly
repositories.notes: Excludes documentation snippets and benchmark-only composition; both are scanned in the package tests but are not a production composition root.

repositories.name: DuendeSoftware_IdentityServer
repositories.notes: The BFF project is a partial composition root: services registered by referenced IdentityServer projects are not in this compilation, so DI015 findings here are baseline signal, not proof of a missing app registration.

repositories.name: dapr_dotnet-sdk
repositories.notes: Targets the actor project so the solution's test projects stay out of the baseline. The project graph also covers Dapr.Client and Dapr.Common.

repositories.name: microsoft_dotnet-podcasts
repositories.notes: Services solution: APIs, workers, and shared service defaults. The client projects are intentionally out of scope.

repositories.name: openiddict_openiddict-core
repositories.notes: Targets the client project because the full solution contains every provider and integration package, which is unnecessary for a DI regression signal.

repositories.name: ThreeMammals_Ocelot
repositories.notes: Excludes benchmark-only composition; the production gateway solution remains in scope.

repositories.name: MassTransit_MassTransit
repositories.notes: Targets the core library project, not the full solution. MassTransit's generic Bind<TBus, T> wrappers are a deliberate stress test for open-generic and type-parameter handling.

repositories.name: khellang_Scrutor
repositories.notes: A clean baseline: a dependency-injection scanning library that does not itself trip the lifetime rules.

repositories.name: Autofac_Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection
repositories.notes: Alternate-container bridge. The analyzer must not treat Autofac's service-resolution APIs as Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection evidence.

repositories.name: jasontaylordev_CleanArchitecture
repositories.notes: Full solution: Web, Application, Infrastructure, Aspire host, and tests. Exercises cross-method composition and third-party registration helpers.

repositories.name: elsa-workflows_elsa-core
repositories.notes: Targets the workflow runtime project. Features registered by referenced management/expressions projects are outside this compilation, so DI015 findings are baseline signal, not proof of a missing app registration.
